title: Candidate Manager / Resourcer
description:
Candidate Manager

Leeds City Centre Full-Time Permanent

Are you a people person with excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to work? Looking to build a long-term career with a growing, award-winning recruitment business?

Prospero Teaching is one of the UK's leading education recruitment agencies, and due to continued growth, we're looking for a Candidate Manager to join our successful Children's Educational Services (CES) team in Leeds.

In this role, you'll be responsible for sourcing, screening and supporting candidates, helping to connect talented education professionals with opportunities that make a real difference to young people's lives.

Key Responsibilities:
- Source and attract candidates through job boards, LinkedIn and referrals
- Conduct candidate screening calls and Teams interviews
- Manage candidate registrations and onboarding
- Build strong relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment process
- Create candidate profiles and support consultants with live vacancies
- Work closely with Compliance Officers to ensure candidate files are complete
- Deliver an exceptional candidate experience

What We're Looking For:
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail
- Positive, motivated and proactive attitude
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
- Recruitment, sales, customer service or administration experience is advantageous but not essential

Why Join Prospero?
- Industry-leading training and development
- Clear progression opportunities
- Supportive and collaborative team culture
- Modern Leeds city centre office
- Opportunity to build a successful career within recruitment

If you're ambitious, driven and enjoy working with people, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: HR Officer
description:
As an HR Officer in Leeds, you will handle the day-to-day HR work that helps colleagues and managers across the Business Services organisation. You will keep people processes organised, provide clear guidance and help the Human Resources department run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Business Services sector in Leeds.

Description
- Manage day-to-day HR administration to keep employee records accurate and up to date.
- Provide practical HR guidance to employees and managers on people-related queries.
- Prepare HR letters, documents and reports to support clear and consistent communication.
- Coordinate onboarding activity so new starters receive the right information and paperwork.
- Maintain HR systems and files, ensuring information is organised and easy to access.
- Work with colleagues across the business to support effective people processes.
- Help deliver HR initiatives and administrative projects within the Human Resources department.
- Handle confidential employee information with care and professionalism.

Profile

A successful 'HR Officer' should have:
- Experience of managing HR administration and maintaining employee records.
- Confidence in responding to HR queries from employees and managers.
- Ability to prepare clear HR correspondence, documents and reports.
- Experience of supporting onboarding and new starter administration.
- Good working knowledge of HR systems and accurate data handling.
- Ability to manage confidential information in a professional manner.

Job Offer
- Potential for hybrid and flexible working.
- Bonus scheme for most fee-earning departments.
- 25 days' holiday plus 8 bank holidays and a paid birthday holiday day.
- Business casual dress code.
- Life assurance at 2 x annual salary, pension scheme and salary sacrifice.

30 minute Early Finish (subject to hitting target)

Free onsite drinks social event on the last Friday of each month Dress Down day every Friday

Charity Social events such as outdoor activities, treasure hunts and bake sales

Free Tea & Coffee

Sponsorship of relevant Further Education - subject to a successful application process

Proven track record of internal promotion

On-site Car Valet and Chiropodist visits (Leeds only)

City Centre Location

Private Health Insurance for Senior Staff

title: Temporary HR Administrator - DSAR Project
description:
Temporary HR Administrator - DSAR Project

We're recruiting for an exciting temporary opportunity with a corporate financial services company based in Leeds city centre.

Location: Leeds city centre
Start date: Immediate
Duration: Approximately 4-8 weeks
Pay rate: 17.90 per hour plus holiday pay
Hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week

The Opportunity

We're looking for a detail-oriented HR Administrator to support a time-sensitive Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) project. This role would suit someone with experience in HR administration, auditing, compliance or confidential document review who is confident handling sensitive information and identifying potential risks.
You'll review information retrieved through Mimecast, manually checking emails, folders and documents to identify relevant information and prepare records for redaction and further review.

Key Responsibilities
- Review emails, folders and documents retrieved through Mimecast in response to DSARs.
- Manually examine records to identify information relevant to each request.
- Upload or transfer documents into the designated review system.
- Identify and redact confidential or sensitive information in line with project guidelines.
- Review email correspondence, highlighting information requiring redaction or further investigation.
- Flag potential risks and document the rationale for each decision.
- Apply an understanding of HR processes to identify sensitive employee information and potential risks.
- Maintain accurate records, ensuring all reviews are completed consistently and confidentially.

About You
- Previous experience in HR administration, auditing, compliance, records management or document review.
- An understanding of HR processes and confidential employee information.
- Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to review large volumes of information accurately.
- Confidence identifying sensitive data, potential risks and information requiring escalation.
- Strong written communication skills, particularly when documenting findings and explaining decisions.
- A professional and discreet approach to handling highly confidential information.

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience completing Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs).
- Knowledge of UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.
- Experience using redaction or eDiscovery tools.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong HR administration or auditing experience who enjoys detailed, process-driven work and can quickly identify sensitive information and potential risks.

title: HR Assistant/Generalist-Part-Time
description:
Senior HR Administrator/Generalist -Part-Time

Location: Bradford, BD1
Salary: 29,000 - 32,000 (pro rata, dependent on experience)
Job Type: Permanent, Part-Time
Working Pattern: Flexible part-time hours across the week with shorter working days available. A 4-day working week may also be considered for the right candidate. Hybrid working is available following training and successful integration into the role.
Benefits
- 33 days annual leave including bank holidays, plus additional Birthday day off
- Hybrid working available following successful completion of training and on-boarding
- Private healthcare and well-being packages
- Company pension scheme with employer contributions
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Regular company social events and team activities
- On-site parking
- Flexible part-time working hours to support work-life balance

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced and organised Senior HR Administrator/ Generalist to join a well-established and growing business based in Bradford. This is a varied role combining HR support with payroll support responsibilities when required. Please note you do not need payroll experience.

Whilst previous payroll experience is not essential, candidates must be comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, and data, and be willing to learn payroll processes. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the employee lifecycle, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring all payroll and HR administration is completed accurately and confidentially.

This position offers excellent flexibility, making it ideal for someone seeking a professional role that can fit around family or other personal commitments.

Key Responsibilities

HR Administration
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and HR databases.
- Support the full employee lifecycle, including on-boarding, contract changes, and leaver processes.
- Produce employment contracts, offer letters, and other HR documentation.
- Carry out right-to-work checks and ensure compliance documentation is completed and recorded correctly.
- Ensure HR systems are maintained with a high level of accuracy and data integrity.
- Respond to employee queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Assist with HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the department.

Payroll Administration
- Prepare and process payroll information accurately and within required deadlines.
- Update payroll records including new starters, leavers, salary amendments, and deductions.
- Liaise with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure payroll information is accurate and up to date.
- Support payroll administration activities and assist with payroll-related reporting when required.

Compliance & Reporting
- Ensure compliance with employment legislation, company policies, and internal procedures.
- Produce HR and payroll reports as required.
- Support audits by preparing and providing relevant documentation and records.
- Assist with maintaining accurate compliance records across the department.

General Duties
- Handle confidential employee information with discretion and professionalism.
- Provide administrative support to the wider HR team as required.
- Contribute ideas and improvements to enhance HR and payroll processes.
- Support the business with additional HR administration duties as needed.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience within an HR Administration, HR Assistant, or Senior Administration role.
- Ability to spin a lot of plates within the HR industry and have excellent people skills
- Excellent organisational and administrative skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets, and data.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to build professional relationships.
- The ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

title: Recruitment Administrator
description:
Location: Leeds
Sector: Legal

The Opportunity

An established and growing law firm is seeking an organised and proactive Recruitment Administrator to join its friendly and supportive HR team in Leeds.
Working closely with the Recruitment Manager, you will support recruitment activity across multiple offices, covering experienced hires, graduate recruitment and onboarding.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage recruitment inboxes, screen applications and shortlist candidates.
- Advertise vacancies across job boards, LinkedIn and the company website.
- Coordinate interviews, assessments and candidate communications.
- Liaise with hiring managers, recruitment agencies and internal stakeholders.
- Maintain accurate recruitment records and HR systems.
- Support trainee solicitor and vacation scheme recruitment, including assessment centres and careers fairs.
- Coordinate new starter onboarding, including references, DBS and Right to Work checks.
- Assist with recruitment reporting, employer branding and process improvements.

About You
- Degree educated (2:1 or above) or equivalent.
- Excellent organisational, administrative and communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and working with stakeholders at all levels.
- Proactive, personable and able to work independently.
- Previous recruitment experience within legal or professional services is advantageous but not essential.
- Experience supporting graduate recruitment or assessment centres would be beneficial.

Additional Information: Occasional travel to London and attendance at careers fairs will be required.
This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your recruitment career within a collaborative HR team at a well-established professional services organisation.

title: Recruitment Associate
description:
Recruitment Associate

Location: Head Office Wakefield, West Yorkshire

Hours: Mon Fri, 9am to 5.30pm

We are a well-established team of recruitment specialists, connecting talented individuals with leading organisations across the Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Pharmacy, and Life Sciences sectors. We are currently looking for a Recruitment Associate to join our team at our Head Office in Wakefield, West Yorkshire.

About You:

We are seeking a driven and commercially minded individual with a background in sales, recruitment or customer service. You will be confident engaging with candidates, with a natural ability to build rapport, understand motivations, and effectively promote job opportunities. This role would suit someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to play a more active role in the commercial side of recruitment, rather than purely administrative tasks.

To succeed in this role, you should:
- Have experience in a fast-paced recruitment, sales, or customer service role
- Be confident and professional when speaking over the telephone
- Demonstrate strong influencing and communication skills
- Be target-driven with a proactive approach to workload
- Possess excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Be based within a commutable distance of Wakefield, West Yorkshire

Key Responsibilities:
- Working alongside an experienced recruitment team to engage with candidates and promote relevant job opportunities
- Effectively promoting vacancies by understanding candidate motivations and aligning them to suitable client roles
- Building strong relationships with candidates and maintaining consistent communication throughout the recruitment process
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records within internal CRM systems
- Supporting targeted recruitment campaigns, mailshots, and candidate attraction activities
- Handling incoming calls and candidate enquiries in a professional and efficient manner
- Preparing candidates for interviews using effective coaching and interview techniques
- Providing timely and constructive feedback to candidates throughout the recruitment process
- Delivering a high standard of customer service at all times

What We Offer:

We offer a stable, long-term career opportunity within a supportive and collaborative team environment, with the opportunity to develop commercial skills within recruitment.
- Competitive salary (dependent on experience) plus performance-related commission
- 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays)
- Long-service bonus scheme
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities
- Employer pension contribution
- Free on-site parking
- Additional perks including retail discounts, wellbeing support, and regular team events

Our Values:

Our team is guided by a strong set of values:
- We uphold high standards in everything we do
- We communicate openly and honestly
- We strive to add value in all our work
- We treat others with respect and integrity
- We take pride in enjoying what we do

Application Process
Evolve Selection acts as a recruitment partner on behalf of our clients. All applications are reviewed by our specialist consultants and assessed against the specific requirements of the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted for an initial discussion before being introduced to the hiring client.

We appreciate every application; however, due to application volumes, we may not be able to respond to all candidates individually. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please consider your application unsuccessful for this particular role, however we may contact you regarding future opportunities that match your experience in line with our privacy policy.
